<goal>Add a test module for CountDayBookings.handle that checks it counts only the bookings on the requested day, including the zero cases, using a small fake repository.</goal>
<file path="src/bistro/booking/queries/count_day_bookings__test.py">
from datetime import date
from types import SimpleNamespace

from bistro.booking.queries.count_day_bookings import CountDayBookings, CountDayBookingsInput


class FakeBookings:
    def __init__(self, bookings: list) -> None:
        self._bookings = bookings

    def all(self) -> list:
        return list(self._bookings)


def booking_on(day: date) -> SimpleNamespace:
    return SimpleNamespace(day=day)


def test_counts_only_bookings_on_the_given_day() -> None:
    today = date(2026, 11, 22)
    tomorrow = date(2026, 11, 23)
    repo = FakeBookings([booking_on(today), booking_on(tomorrow), booking_on(today)])

    assert CountDayBookings(repo).handle(CountDayBookingsInput(day=today)) == 2


def test_zero_when_no_bookings_on_the_given_day() -> None:
    repo = FakeBookings([booking_on(date(2026, 11, 23))])

    assert CountDayBookings(repo).handle(CountDayBookingsInput(day=date(2026, 11, 22))) == 0


def test_zero_when_there_are_no_bookings_at_all() -> None:
    repo = FakeBookings([])

    assert CountDayBookings(repo).handle(CountDayBookingsInput(day=date(2026, 11, 22))) == 0
